initial.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Retain and restore complete agent-to-agent conversation history
initial.goal: Make complete A2A exchanges durable, recoverable, and correctly attributable.
initial.required_outcome: Runtime and Observatory can reconstruct both sides of every governed A2A turn after reconnect, restart, checkpoint, or rehydration.
authority_boundary: #713 owns A2A transcript persistence and recovery
#707 retains ownership of its delivery and startup fixes
operator_constraints: All agents use the same communication path
Preserve authentication, signed ACIP identity, replay protection, and redaction
initial.task_boundary: Persist and restore complete, causally correlated A2A transcript records through Runtime API and Observatory.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Record sender, recipient, both message bodies, status, timestamps, and causal IDs
AC-2: Distinguish A2A from operator conversations
AC-3: Use one symmetric ACIP-governed path for every agent
AC-4: Survive reconnect, restart, checkpoint, and rehydration without duplication
AC-5: Expose a bounded authenticated API projection with correct redaction
AC-7: Focused negative and recovery tests pass
AC-8: Live Wuji proof captures and validates raw redacted bidirectional A2A evidence
initial.plan_summary: Unify both halves of an A2A exchange into durable history, expose it through the authenticated API, restore it in Observatory, and prove recovery live.

steps.action: Map existing A2A delivery, reply, history, checkpoint, and Observatory projections.
Implement the durable symmetric causal transcript record and recovery.
Expose the authenticated API projection and Observatory restoration.
Run focused and live bidirectional recovery proof.
Complete independent review and typed publication.

invariants: Agent identities and causal IDs never drift
Secrets and hidden prompts remain private
risks: Existing events may lack one half of the exchange
UI may conflate operator and A2A replies
stop_conditions: Implementation requires weakening ACIP or API authentication
Scope collides with unmerged #707 files without a safe base
History cannot be recovered without inventing missing content

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove causal transcript persistence, replay handling, redaction, and recovery.
Prove authenticated projection and correct transcript restoration.
Prove bidirectional non-Shepherd A2A and recovered transcript from raw redacted evidence.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Create and run after local implementation proof.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on identity, causal-chain, replay, authorization, or redaction mismatch; never manufacture missing transcript content.
review_prompts: Can both halves be reconstructed from Runtime-authoritative evidence?
Is the path identical for all agents?
Can replay, restart, or rehydration duplicate or misattribute a turn?
Does the API redact private provider and prompt data?
initial.review_scope: A2A transcript persistence, causal correlation, API recovery, Observatory attribution, and bounded proof only.
